description:
Write and execute a Gretl hansl script to perform residual diagnostics on the 'food.gdt' dataset.

1. Create a script file at '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/resid_diagnostics.inp'.
2. The script must:
   - Open '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_data/food.gdt'.
   - Estimate an OLS regression of 'food_exp' on 'income'.
   - Generate a scatter plot of residuals vs. fitted values and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/resid_vs_fitted.png'.
   - Generate a residual histogram and save it to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/resid_histogram.png'.
   - Perform the Jarque-Bera normality test on the residuals.
   - Save a text report to '/home/ga/Documents/gretl_output/diagnostics_report.txt' containing the regression coefficients, R-squared, and the Jarque-Bera test statistic/p-value.
3. Run the script to generate these outputs.
